name: WeChat Bridge
description: Connect one WeChat account: its messages go into an inbound session; the agent replies with the wechat__send tool, or a mirrored session forwards everything it writes.
author: augentia

command_prefix.title: Command prefix
command_prefix.description: WeChat messages starting with this are bridge commands (\cmd bind, \cmd unbind, \cmd status, \cmd help) and are not sent to the agent.

message_prefix.title: Message prefix
message_prefix.description: Prepended to every WeChat message the agent receives.
message_prefix.default: [from WeChat; reply with the wechat__send tool]
